latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of TikTok Live Cart Automation skill.

- Automates detection of pinned products during TikTok Live streams.
- Automatically adds detected products to the cart and prepares for checkout.
- Requires manual confirmation for the final purchase to ensure security.
- Includes sample scripts for full automation, monitoring, and cart actions.
- Supports headless automation and custom monitoring durations.
- Requires Selenium, ChromeDriver, and TikTok Live API library for full functionality.
